scripts.dev: npm run kill:all && concurrently "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.kill:all: taskkill /F /IM node.exe 2>nul || echo No Node processes to kill
scripts.kill:backend: netstat -ano | findstr :4001 | findstr LISTENING | for /f "tokens=5" %a in ('findstr LISTENING') do taskkill /F /PID %a 2>nul || echo No backend process to kill
scripts.kill:frontend: netstat -ano | findstr :5173 | findstr LISTENING | for /f "tokens=5" %a in ('findstr LISTENING') do taskkill /F /PID %a 2>nul || echo No frontend process to kill
scripts.clean: npm run kill:all && npm run kill:backend && npm run kill:frontend
